title: In text-heavy/cluttered scenes, don’t try to remove all background…
content:
In text-heavy/cluttered scenes, don’t try to remove all background text—explicitly protect the key object by prompting that the hero prop must be completely clean with NO price tag, NO sticker, NO label, NO maker’s mark, NO writing.  
For comedic timing, end the scene on the object with hands still in frame and hold the shot for ~2 seconds to preserve the punchline silence.  
Avoid ending punchlines with partial faces at the frame edge; frame the ending on hands/object instead to prevent truncation and lost timing.  
Use a shot list with explicit per-shot camera_motion (e.g., static), framing (MS/MCU/CU/ECU), and speed (100%) to stabilize continuity across cuts.  
Add negative prompts for common text sources (no newspapers, no open books, no magazines, no chalkboards, no signage) to reduce unwanted readable text in frame.  
Lock character/prop continuity by assigning prop ownership and visual anchors in the prompt (e.g., who wears which glasses/chain, which bag belongs to whom).  
Generate the final faceless hold shot first, then the punchline shot, to anchor the hero prop’s look and keep it consistent across the sequence.

es.content:
En escenas con mucho texto o muy recargadas, no intentes eliminar todo el texto del fondo: protege explícitamente el objeto clave indicando en el prompt que el hero prop debe estar completamente limpio, sin ETIQUETA DE PRECIO, sin sticker, sin label, sin marca del fabricante, sin escritura.  
Para el timing cómico, termina la escena con el objeto mientras las manos siguen en cuadro y mantén el plano durante ~2 segundos para preservar el silencio del remate.  
Evita cerrar los remates con rostros parciales en el borde del encuadre; en su lugar, encuadra el final sobre las manos/objeto para evitar recortes y pérdida de timing.  
Usa una shot list con camera_motion explícito por plano (p. ej., static), framing (MS/MCU/CU/ECU) y speed (100%) para estabilizar la continuidad entre cortes.  
Añade negative prompts para fuentes comunes de texto (sin periódicos, sin libros abiertos, sin revistas, sin pizarras, sin señalización) para reducir el texto legible no deseado en cuadro.  
Bloquea la continuidad de personajes/props asignando la propiedad de los objetos y anclas visuales en el prompt (p. ej., quién lleva qué gafas/cadena, qué bolso pertenece a quién).  
Genera primero el plano final sin rostro de hold, y luego el plano del remate, para anclar el aspecto del hero prop y mantenerlo consistente a lo largo de la secuencia.

• PROPIEDAD DE LOS PROPS: el bolso tote de lona pertenece solo a GRANT. Las gafas de lectura con cadena de cuentas pertenecen solo a RUTH — GRANT lleva gafas redondas de montura metálica en la cara, nunca con cadena.
• personajes:
  - GRANT: edad principios de los 30. visual_anchors: blazer de pana color canela sobre camiseta negra, bolso tote de lona en el HOMBRO IZQUIERDO, gafas redondas de montura metálica, barba oscura cuidada, anillo de sello de plata en el meñique DERECHO. voice: eager mid-range, slightly breathless, American
  - RUTH: edad finales de los 60. visual_anchors: cárdigan granate oversize, gafas de lectura con cadena de cuentas apoyadas en el pecho, pelo corto plateado, paño suave en las manos. voice: dry older female, unhurried, American

LISTA DE SECUENCIA:
PLANO 1 (0-3.5s) ESTABLECIMIENTO — MS sobre GRANT
• vfx: none. Speed 100%

• action_visual: GRANT gira lentamente la base de lámpara limpia y sin marcas contra la luz, entrecerrando los ojos a lo largo del borde
• dialog: SOLO habla GRANT. GRANT (eager mid-range, slightly breathless), then says: 'This is a genuine mid-century piece. How much?'

(CUT TO)
PLANO 2 (3.5-5.5s) — MCU sobre RUTH

• action_visual: RUTH sigue puliendo una pequeña baratija de latón con un paño, sin levantar la vista

PLANO 3 (5.5-8s) — CU sobre GRANT

• dialog: GRANT (eager mid-range, slightly breathless), rising hopeful inflection, then says: 'Two hundred?'
• exit: GRANT espera
(CUT TO)
PLANO 4 (8-10.5s) — MS sobre RUTH
• vfx: none. Speed 100%
• camera_motion: static, más amplio que el Plano 2
• action_visual: RUTH por fin levanta la vista, con el rostro imperturbable e inalterado
• dialog: SOLO RUTH está en cuadro. RUTH (dry older female, unhurried), then says: 'Two.' GRANT off-screen, not visible (eager mid-range, slightly breathless), then says: 'You don't know what you have.'

• vfx: none. Speed 100%
• camera_motion: static, a la altura de los ojos

• dialog: RUTH (dry older female, unhurried), stress on the second 'lamp', then says: 'I do. It's a lamp base. From a lamp.'

(CUT TO)
PLANO 6 (13-15s) PLANO FINAL DE HOLD — ECU sobre la base de la lámpara sola en el mostrador, sin rostro en cuadro

• camera_motion: static macro sobre la base de lámpara de cerámica crema lisa y sin marcas, sola sobre el mostrador de madera. NO FACE VISIBLE, no head in frame, no hands in frame, only the object
• action_visual: nadie en cuadro, nadie habla. Quietud total durante los 2 segundos completos, sin movimiento, sin movimiento de cámara. SFX: solo ventilador de techo, continúa el room tone
• exit: la base de la lámpara permanece inmóvil en el silencio

GENERATE FIRST: Shot 6 (faceless final hold on the clean lamp base), Shot 5 (deadpan punchline)

fr.content:
Dans les scènes très chargées en texte / encombrées, n’essaie pas de supprimer tout le texte de fond — protège explicitement l’objet clé en indiquant dans le prompt que l’accessoire principal doit être parfaitement propre, sans étiquette de prix, sans autocollant, sans label, sans marque du fabricant, sans écriture.  
Pour un bon timing comique, termine la scène sur l’objet avec les mains encore dans le cadre et maintiens le plan pendant environ 2 secondes afin de préserver le silence qui fait mouche.  
Évite de conclure les punchlines avec des visages partiels au bord du cadre ; termine plutôt sur les mains / l’objet pour éviter la troncature et la perte de timing.  
Utilise une shot list avec camera_motion explicite par plan (par ex. static), framing (MS/MCU/CU/ECU) et speed (100 %) pour stabiliser la continuité entre les cuts.  
Ajoute des negative prompts pour les sources courantes de texte (no newspapers, no open books, no magazines, no chalkboards, no signage) afin de réduire le texte lisible indésirable dans le cadre.  
Verrouille la continuité des personnages / accessoires en attribuant la propriété des objets et des repères visuels dans le prompt (par ex. qui porte quelles lunettes / chaîne, quel sac appartient à qui).  
Génère d’abord le plan final en hold sans visage, puis le plan de punchline, afin d’ancrer l’apparence de l’accessoire principal et de la garder cohérente tout au long de la séquence.

--- CONTINUATION DU FIL ---

• no newspapers, no open books, no magazines, no chalkboards, no signage dans le cadre  
• PROPRIÉTÉ DES ACCESSOIRES : le tote bag en toile appartient uniquement à GRANT. Les lunettes de lecture sur chaîne perlée appartiennent uniquement à RUTH — GRANT porte des lunettes rondes à monture métallique sur son visage, jamais de chaîne.

ja.content:
テキストが多い／散らかったシーンでは、背景の文字をすべて消そうとしないこと。代わりに、ヒーロー小道具は完全にクリーンでなければならないと明示的に指定して保護する。つまり、NO price tag、NO sticker、NO label、NO maker’s mark、NO writing。  
コメディの間合いを出すには、シーンの最後をオブジェクトで締め、手はまだフレーム内に残したまま、約2秒ショットをキープして、オチの沈黙を保つ。  
オチをフレーム端の顔の一部で終わらせないこと。代わりに、最後は手／オブジェクトにフレーミングして、切れやタイミングの崩れを防ぐ。  
カット間の連続性を安定させるため、各ショットごとの camera_motion（例: static）、framing（MS/MCU/CU/ECU）、speed（100%）を明示した shot list を使う。  
フレーム内に読める文字が入るのを減らすため、一般的な文字ソースに対する negative prompts を追加する（no newspapers, no open books, no magazines, no chalkboards, no signage）。  
小道具の所有権と視覚的アンカーを prompt 内で割り当てて、キャラクター／小道具の連続性を固定する（例: どの眼鏡／チェーンを誰が着けるか、どのバッグが誰のものか）。  
まず最後の faceless hold shot を生成し、その後に punchline shot を生成して、ヒーロー小道具の見た目を固定し、シーケンス全体で一貫性を保つ。

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] SCENE 1 (0:00-0:15) — 鑑定 → 価格 → 不信 → 破壊
SHOT STRUCTURE: 6 shots, 15 seconds, 16:9

GLOBAL STYLE NOTES:
• lighting_philosophy: camera-left から差し込む埃っぽい窓光、天井の蛍光灯1本、混在して不均一
• color_grade: muted neutral, low saturation — brown shelving, faded fabric, yellowed ceramic
• setting: cluttered thrift shop, wooden counter stacked with unsorted bric-a-brac, crowded shelves behind, afternoon
• ambience: ceiling fan, distant door chime, no music
• the ceramic lamp base is the hero prop and must be completely clean: plain unglazed cream ceramic, NO price tag, NO sticker, NO label, NO maker's mark, NO writing of any kind on it
• no newspapers, no open books, no magazines, no chalkboards, no signage in frame
• PROP OWNERSHIP: the canvas tote belongs to GRANT only. The reading glasses on a beaded chain belong to RUTH only — GRANT wears round wire glasses on his face, never a chain.
• characters:
  - GRANT: age early 30s. visual_anchors: tan corduroy blazer over black tee, canvas tote on LEFT shoulder, round wire glasses, neat dark beard, silver signet ring on RIGHT little finger. voice: eager mid-range, slightly breathless, American
  - RUTH: age late 60s. visual_anchors: oversized maroon cardigan, reading glasses on a beaded chain resting on her chest, silver bob haircut, soft cloth in her hands. voice: dry older female, unhurried, American

SEQUENCE LIST:
SHOT 1 (0-3.5s) ESTABLISH — MS on GRANT
• vfx: none. Speed 100%
• camera_motion: static, GRANT holding a plain cream ceramic lamp base up toward the window
• action_visual: GRANT rotates the clean unmarked lamp base slowly against the light, squinting along its edge. SFX: ceiling fan
• dialog: ONLY GRANT speaks. GRANT (eager mid-range, slightly breathless), then says: 'This is a genuine mid-century piece. How much?'
• exit: GRANT lowers the object toward the counter
(CUT TO)
SHOT 2 (3.5-5.5s) — MCU on RUTH
• vfx: none. Speed 100%
• camera_motion: static, eye level behind the counter
• action_visual: RUTH keeps polishing a small brass trinket with a cloth, does not look up
• dialog: RUTH (dry older female, unhurried), flat and bored, then says: 'Two dollars.'
• exit: RUTH keeps polishing
(CUT TO)
SHOT 3 (5.5-8s) — CU on GRANT
• vfx: none. Speed 100%
• camera_motion: static, tight
• action_visual: GRANT's grip tightens on the lamp base, head tilting
• dialog: GRANT (eager mid-range, slightly breathless), rising hopeful inflection, then says: 'Two hundred?'
• exit: GRANT waits
(CUT TO)
SHOT 4 (8-10.5s) — MS on RUTH
• vfx: none. Speed 100%
• camera_motion: static, wider than Shot 2
• action_visual: RUTH finally lifts her eyes, face unimpressed and unchanged
• dialog: ONLY RUTH is in frame. RUTH (dry older female, unhurried), then says: 'Two.' GRANT off-screen, not visible (eager mid-range, slightly breathless), then says: 'You don't know what you have.'
• exit: RUTH sets the cloth down
(CUT TO)
SHOT 5 (10.5-13s) PUNCHLINE — MCU on RUTH
• vfx: none. Speed 100%
• camera_motion: static, eye level
• action_visual: RUTH is deadpan, eyes level and calm, face completely still, no smirk, no raised eyebrows, no reaction at all. She taps the top of the lamp base once with one finger
• dialog: RUTH (dry older female, unhurried), stress on the second 'lamp', then says: 'I do. It's a lamp base. From a lamp.'
• exit: RUTH's hand withdraws from the object
(CUT TO)
SHOT 6 (13-15s) FINAL HOLD — ECU on the lamp base alone on the counter, no face in frame

ko.content:
텍스트가 많고 어수선한 장면에서는 배경의 모든 텍스트를 지우려 하지 말고, 히어로 소품이 완전히 깨끗해야 한다고 프롬프트에 명시적으로 적어 핵심 오브젝트를 보호하세요. 즉, 가격표 NO, 스티커 NO, 라벨 NO, 제작자 표식 NO, 글씨 NO가 있어야 합니다.  
코미디 타이밍을 위해서는 장면을 오브젝트에 맞춰 끝내되 손이 프레임 안에 남아 있게 하고, punchline의 침묵을 살리기 위해 샷을 약 2초간 유지하세요.  
프레임 가장자리에 얼굴이 일부만 걸린 상태로 punchline을 끝내지 마세요. 대신 손/오브젝트에 맞춰 엔딩을 잡아 잘림과 타이밍 손실을 방지하세요.  
컷 전반의 연속성을 안정시키기 위해 shot list에 샷별 camera_motion(예: static), framing(MS/MCU/CU/ECU), speed(100%)를 명시적으로 넣으세요.  
신문, 열린 책, 잡지, 칠판, 간판처럼 텍스트가 자주 생기는 요소에는 negative prompt를 추가해 프레임 안의 원치 않는 읽을 수 있는 텍스트를 줄이세요.  
소품 소유권과 시각적 앵커를 프롬프트에 넣어 캐릭터/소품의 연속성을 고정하세요(예: 누가 어떤 안경/체인을 착용하는지, 어떤 가방이 누구의 것인지).  
마지막 faceless hold shot을 먼저 생성한 뒤 punchline shot을 생성해, 히어로 소품의 외형을 고정하고 시퀀스 전체에서 일관되게 유지하세요.

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] SCENE 1 (0:00-0:15) — 감정평가 → 가격 → 불신 → 파괴
SHOT STRUCTURE: 6 shots, 15 seconds, 16:9

GLOBAL STYLE NOTES:
• lighting_philosophy: 카메라 왼쪽에서 들어오는 먼지 낀 창문빛, 천장 위 단일 형광등, 혼합되고 고르지 않음
• color_grade: 절제된 중성 톤, 낮은 채도 — 갈색 선반, 바랜 천, 누렇게 변한 도자기
• setting: 어수선한 빈티지 숍, 정리되지 않은 잡동사니가 쌓인 나무 카운터, 뒤쪽으로 빽빽한 선반들, 오후
• ambience: 천장 선풍기, 멀리서 들리는 문종 소리, 음악 없음

pt.content:
Em cenas com muito texto/desordem visual, não tente remover todo o texto de fundo — proteja explicitamente o objeto principal, instruindo no prompt que o hero prop deve estar completamente limpo, sem etiqueta de preço, sem adesivo, sem rótulo, sem marca do fabricante, sem escrita.  
Para o timing cômico, termine a cena no objeto, com as mãos ainda em quadro, e segure o plano por cerca de 2 segundos para preservar o silêncio da punchline.  
Evite encerrar punchlines com rostos parciais na borda do quadro; enquadre o final nas mãos/objeto em vez disso, para evitar truncamento e perda de timing.  
Use uma shot list com camera_motion explícito por plano (por exemplo, static), framing (MS/MCU/CU/ECU) e speed (100%) para estabilizar a continuidade entre cortes.  
Adicione negative prompts para fontes comuns de texto (sem jornais, sem livros abertos, sem revistas, sem quadros-negros, sem sinalização) para reduzir texto legível indesejado no quadro.  
Trave a continuidade de personagem/objeto atribuindo a posse dos props e âncoras visuais no prompt (por exemplo, quem usa quais óculos/corrente, qual bolsa pertence a quem).  
Gere primeiro o plano final de hold sem rosto, depois o plano da punchline, para ancorar a aparência do hero prop e mantê-la consistente ao longo da sequência.

zh.content:
在文字密集/杂乱的场景中，不要试图清除所有背景文字——要通过 prompt 明确保护关键物体，强调 hero prop 必须完全干净，不能有任何价签、贴纸、标签、制造商标记或文字。  
为了把握喜剧节奏，场景最后要停在物体上，手仍然留在画面里，并将镜头保持约 2 秒，以保留笑点后的沉默感。  
避免用画面边缘的半张脸来收尾笑点；结尾应构图在手/物体上，以防止截断和节奏丢失。  
使用 shot list，并为每个镜头明确写出 camera_motion（例如 static）、framing（MS/MCU/CU/ECU）和 speed（100%），以稳定剪辑间的连续性。  
为常见文字来源添加 negative prompts（如 no newspapers, no open books, no magazines, no chalkboards, no signage），以减少画面中出现不想要的可读文字。  
通过在 prompt 中分配道具归属和视觉锚点来锁定角色/道具连续性（例如谁戴哪副眼镜/链子，哪个包属于谁）。  
先生成最后那个无脸停留镜头，再生成笑点镜头，以锚定 hero prop 的外观，并让它在整个序列中保持一致。
